summary: AEVEX Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement regarding its initial public offering (IPO) of Class A common stock. On April 16, 2026, the company entered into an underwriting agreement with Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, and Jefferies to sell 16,000,000 firm shares at $20.00 per share, plus a 30-day overallotment option for 2,400,000 shares, which was fully exercised. The IPO closed on April 20, 2026. The filing also describes customary agreements entered at closing. This IPO is a capital-raising event, not a special situation covering acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns.
